sources.title: IBM i — Using the command prompt display (F4)

asciiPanel:
Revoke Object Authority (RVKOBJAUT)

Type choices, press Enter.

Object . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > PAYROLL/PAYMST
Object type . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *FILE
Users . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > APCLERK
Authority . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *USE

Bottom
F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=All parameters   F12=Cancel
F13=How to use this display   F24=More keys
notes: F4 prompt panel for RVKOBJAUT — mirror of GRTOBJAUT parameter layout. USER(*ALL) and AUTL parameters documented in Security Reference; revoking can leave users with more authority via AUTL.
